name: peacebestill
description: Quiet the web down. A family of small, switch-driven extensions, one per site.

scripts.build:youtube: npm run build:youtube:store && npm run build:youtube:selfhosted
scripts.build:youtube:selfhosted: node scripts/variant.mjs --src extensions/youtube/src --out dist/self-hosted/youtube --assets peacebestill-youtube && web-ext build --source-dir dist/self-hosted/youtube --artifacts-dir dist --overwrite-dest --filename peacebestill-youtube.zip
